purpose: Separate prospective v9b valid-AOBT route, preserving the frozen v9 history
training: Reuse saved movement-only complement-fold models without changes; conditional fresh and full refits use exactly the frozen movement architecture
reference: Locally promoted clipped v7 candidate on all finite 2025 OOF rows
prediction_gate: Held-out month, all finite target and own AOBT proxy in [0,7200] seconds
prediction_policy: Saved model best_round, direct prediction clipped >=0; all finite valid-AOBT IDs; no model retraining

existing_fold_selection.formula: clip(v7_candidate + weight*(movement_direct-v7_candidate), lower=0) on valid-AOBT only
existing_fold_selection.selection: minimum January/July all-finite RMSE, tie to smaller weight
existing_fold_selection.gate: nonzero weight, RMSE gain and UTC-day bootstrap 95% lower gain >0 separately in both folds

fresh_audit.movement_model: reuse saved movement-only April/October refit; if absent and valid-AOBT existing-fold gates pass, fit exactly once in the separate v9b namespace with unchanged movement-only architecture
fresh_audit.fallback_training: same movement-only ordinary target [0,7200], same calendar-day modulo-11 early stop, with April/October excluded from fit and early stop
fresh_audit.comparator: v7 fixed fresh blend of depth10 ARR prior and v7 fresh expert
fresh_audit.gate: exact valid-AOBT IDs, both April and October point RMSE gains, and pooled UTC-day bootstrap 95% lower gain >0

final_model.reuse: if original no-NM movement route passes, reuse its saved full ordinary model
final_model.fallback: if original no-NM route fails but v9b passes, one v9b full ordinary fit with unchanged movement-only params and median existing-fold best rounds
final_model.restart: saved model requires matching model/fit-manifest hashes and feature schema

ranking: blend only valid-AOBT rows of an exact-order v7 ranking reference; every invalid-AOBT value remains unchanged
decision: accept only after both existing folds and fresh audit pass; otherwise reject without retuning
limitations: Repeated 2025 comparisons; this estimates a model difference, not untouched 2026 accuracy.
